paragraphs.en: For the first time in history more people live in towns than in the country. In Britain this has had a curious result.While polls show Britons rate “the countryside” alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
paragraphs.zh: 历史上第一次，居住在城镇的人数超过了居住在乡村的人数。在英国，这带来了一个奇特的结果。民意调查显示，英国人将“乡村”与王室、莎士比亚和国民医疗服务体系并列，视为最令他们为祖国感到自豪的事物，但这种态度得到的政治支持却十分有限。

paragraphs.en: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save “the beauty of natural places for everyone forever.” It was specifically to provide city dwellers with spaces for leisure where they could experience “a refreshing air.” Hill’s pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts. They don’t make countryside any more, and every year concrete consumes more of it. It needs constant guardianship.
paragraphs.zh: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维娅·希尔发起成立国民信托组织，目的不是挽救精美宅邸，而是“为所有人永久保存自然之美”。具体说来，就是为城市居民提供休闲空间，让他们能在那里体验“清新的空气”。希尔的推动后来促成了国家公园和绿化带的建立。乡村已无法再生，而混凝土每年都在吞噬更多乡村土地。乡村需要持续的守护。

paragraphs.en: At the next election none of the big parties seem likely to endorse this sentiment. The Conservatives’ planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorising “off-plan” building where local people might object. The concept of sustainable development has been defined as profitable. Labour likewise wants to discontinue local planning where councils oppose development. The Liberal Democrats are silent. Only Ukip, sensing its chance, has sided with those pleading for a more considered approach to using green land. Its Campaign to Protect Rural England struck terror into many local Conservative parties.
paragraphs.zh: 在下一次选举中，几大政党似乎都不太可能支持这种想法。保守党的规划改革明确将乡村开发置于保护之上，甚至允许在当地居民可能反对的地方进行“规划之外”的建设。可持续发展的概念已被定义为有利可图。工党同样希望，在地方议会反对开发时，取消当地的规划。自由民主党则保持沉默。只有英国独立党嗅到了机会，站到了那些呼吁更审慎使用绿地的人一边。它发起的保护英格兰乡村运动，令许多地方保守党组织惊恐不已。

paragraphs.en: The sensible place to build new houses, factories and offices is where people are, in cities and towns where infrastructure is in place. The London agents Stirling Ackroyd recently identified enough sites for half a million houses in the London area alone, with no intrusion on green belt. What is true of London is even truer of the provinces.
paragraphs.zh: 新建住宅、工厂和办公楼的合理地点，应当是人口聚居、基础设施齐备的城镇。伦敦房地产中介斯特林·阿克罗伊德最近发现，仅伦敦地区就有足以建造五十万套住宅的地块，而且无须侵占绿化带。伦敦尚且如此，外省地区就更是如此。

paragraphs.en: The idea that “housing crisis” equals “concreted meadows” is pure lobby talk. The issue is not the need for more houses but, as always, where to put them. Under lobby pressure, George Osborne favours rural new-build against urban renovation and renewal. He favours out-of-town shopping sites against high streets. This is not a free market but a biased one. Rural towns and villages have grown and will always grow. They do so best where building sticks to their edges and respects their character. We do not ruin urban conservation areas. Why ruin rural ones?
paragraphs.zh: 认为“住房危机”等于“用混凝土覆盖草地”，纯粹是游说集团的说辞。问题不在于是否需要更多住房，而是一如既往，在于把住房建在哪里。在游说压力下，乔治·奥斯本偏向乡村新建项目，而不是城市改造和更新；他偏向城外购物区，而不是市中心商业街。这并非自由市场，而是有所偏袒的市场。乡间城镇和村庄一直在发展，也将始终发展下去。当建设紧贴其边缘、尊重其原有风貌时，它们才能发展得最好。我们不会破坏城市保护区，为什么要破坏乡村保护区呢？

paragraphs.en: Development should be planned, not let rip. After the Netherlands, Britain is Europe’s most crowded country. Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living. There is no doubt of the alternative – the corrupted landscapes of southern Portugal, Spain or Ireland. Avoiding this rather than promoting it should unite the left and right of the political spectrum.
paragraphs.zh: 开发应当经过规划，不能任其肆意扩张。英国是欧洲仅次于荷兰的人口最稠密的国家。半个世纪的城乡规划，使它既保留了令人羡慕的乡村整体风貌，又允许低密度的城市生活。另一条道路会带来什么，毫无疑问——看看葡萄牙南部、西班牙或爱尔兰那些遭到破坏的景观就知道了。避免这种结果，而不是助长它，应该成为团结政治光谱左右两派的共同目标。
